dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and '8' shaped high-contrast structures on the lateral flank exhibit thin, high-intensity white perimeters with irregular, jagged outer margins. The interior of these rings contains a lower-intensity, mottled gradient transitioning from the bright exterior edge to a darker center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated primarily along a jagged, linear boundary separating the dorsal and lateral regions, rather than forming isolated circular nodes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent mid-lateral annuli form a wide, obtuse triangle. A secondary cluster of smaller annuli towards the posterior creates a roughly linear, horizontal spatial relationship relative to the largest mid-body annulus.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, continuous, high-contrast white serrated line extends longitudinally along the upper-lateral surface, framing the cluster of circular patterns below it.
